notes: every chart: 800 x 600, SVG ssr (chart._ssr false), animation false; the gallery options fed verbatim.
Math.random is the port's xorshift32 from 2463534242, reset before every chart.

a gauge, a sunburst, and a chord with no usage are laid out on the canvas whatever they name: their layouts never ask createBoxLayoutReference (gauge, sunburst) or have no box coordinate system (data usage).

cases.note: a grid over a 3 x 3 range of cells, its default box (10% / 60 / 60) and outer bounds on the cell
four grids in cells: px / percent edges with outerBoundsMode none, containLabel, axis names on the default box, outerBounds and a size
a grid on one cell of a merged block: dataToLayout expands it to the block
grids in calendar days: the content rect; outerBoundsMode none, and the default box
grids whose host gives them nothing: usage 'data', a matrixIndex not there, a coordinate system that hosts no component, a usage word that is neither; and one by matrixId on a second matrix
polars in cells: the default centre and radius, a percentage centre and a mixed radius over a range
a polar in a calendar day

titles in cells: centred, right and bottom with padding, a percentage left over a range, the defaults, a coord that names no cell, and two the host gives nothing (a matrixIndex not there, usage 'data')
titles in calendar days: centred in the content rect, and right-aligned
legends in cells: a horizontal one wrapping in its cell, a vertical one on the right of another
a legend in a calendar day
pies: by coord with a percentage radius, by center read as a coord, by coord with a percentage centre and a ring, on a calendar day by coord and by center, and one whose matrix is not there
funnels in a matrix cell (a left and a percentage width) and in a calendar day

sankeys: the default box over a range of cells, edges at zero in a calendar day, and one whose calendar is not there (one whose matrix is not there throws: createGraphFromNodeEdge asks the matrix for its dimensions)
trees in cells: orthogonal with the default box, radial over a range
treemaps: one over a range of cells with its breadcrumb, one in a calendar day with no breadcrumb
graphs with usage 'box': layout none in a cell, circular over a range, none in a calendar day
chords: usage 'box' in a cell, on a calendar day, and with no usage (a series' default 'data': the canvas)
a gauge (no usage and 'box') and a sunburst ('box') naming a matrix cell: their layouts read the canvas
the gallery: five grids (time axes with breaks) and four titles in merged cells

every case draws something boxed
a default grid shrinks inside its cell, not the canvas
outerBoundsMode none keeps the cell's box exactly
a merged block expands the grid's cell
a grid in a calendar day takes the content rect (a half pixel in)
fallbacks are on the canvas, matrixId finds the second matrix
a polar's default centre is its cell's centre
a polar's radius is of half its cell's shorter side
a centred title is centred on its cell
a title whose coord names no column is placed in its row at x nought (getLayoutRect: containerRect.x || 0, left || 0)
a title in a calendar day is in its content rect (right 0 keeps the left align: `left || right` is 0)
a legend wraps in its cell: its items stack
a vertical legend sits on its cell's right edge
a pie by center sits at the cell's centre
a pie on a calendar day by center sits at the content rect's centre
a pie whose matrix is not there is on the canvas
a funnel in a calendar day is in it
a sankey at zero edges fills its day
a radial tree is in its cells
the treemap's breadcrumb is in its cells
a graph with usage box lays its view in the cell
a chord with usage box is in its cell, with none on the canvas
a gauge and a sunburst naming a cell are on the canvas
the stock's five grids and four titles are in its cells
